note: Single column. Page covers the GUIDANCE DEPARTMENT and SPECIAL NEEDS DEPARTMENT, not tied to one building, so page school is district-wide; each entry carries a school only where its printed role names one: 'Middle School' -> middle (Light, Haggerty, Hughes; note the 1975 report also prints TURKEY HILL MIDDLE SCHOOL on other pages, same building probably, but this page says only 'Middle School' so I kept middle); 'Elementary School' -> passios (Weizenbaum, Curtis, Murray; the only elementary building in the 1975 report is Passios, grades K-4 - an inference from other pages); Walker (Guiance [sic] Secretary) names no building -> unknown. Roles spanning grades/buildings (Director of Guidance K-12, Elementary/Middle Grs 4-7, Psychologist/High School counselor, Director of Special Education K-12, LD Academic K-7, Speech K-12) -> district-wide. Miss Claire Haggerty is a cooperative intern (9/9/75-12/19/75) - kept. Roles run over following lines; those and education lines ignored. Integration pass, 31 Oct 2026: school bus contractors, drivers and volunteers moved from entries to ignored (not school staff; every 1971-1980 page treated alike), and `middle` written `turkey-hill` -- the 1972 and 1974 listings print the building as `Turkey Hill Middle School (Grades 5-7)`, the town's one middle school.
